title: GTA 6 Fans Outraged by $400 Collector's Set Without Game
description: GTA 6 fans are outraged over a $400 collector's set that excludes the game, comparing it to Red Dead Redemption 2's version. Read the latest from IGN Games.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Fans Outraged by $400 Collector's Set That Doesn't Include the Game

As anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster reaches unprecedented levels, the community is keeping a close eye on every piece of merchandise and announcement. According to a recent report by IGN Games, GTA 6 fans are not thrilled about a newly surfaced $400 collector's set—primarily because it does not include the game itself.

### Community Backlash and Red Dead Comparisons

Following the news, fans took to various platforms to express their outrage, drawing direct comparisons to previous Rockstar collector's editions, most notably the version released for Red Dead Redemption 2. For many long-time fans, the expectation for a premium collector's set at this price point has historically involved receiving the game alongside physical memorabilia. 

While high-priced collector's bundles lacking game discs or digital codes have become an increasingly common industry trend in recent years, the reaction to this specific $400 set highlights the high stakes and immense expectations surrounding the GTA franchise. Fans are demanding better value and clearer communication regarding what their money is actually buying.

### Editor's Take

Charging $400 for a collector's set that omits the actual game is always going to be a tough sell. When fans compare it to past releases like Red Dead Redemption 2, the discontent is entirely understandable. Publishers need to align their pricing strategies with tangible consumer value, especially for a community as passionate as GTA's.
